description: Power on from Stop, set operation_mode=Cooling, temperature=24.0. First attempt with the carried-over temperature=0.0 (from Stop's cached status) was rejected by the server -- see notes.
notes: Rejected attempt (not saved as a separate fixture): same payload but temperature=0.0 (carried over unmodified from the prior Stop-mode status) -> HTTP error, code E-21291-01712, message 'アプリケーションエラーが発生しました。ご迷惑をおかけし申し訳ございません。' (generic 'an application error occurred'). Strongly suggests the server validates temperature against the target operation_mode when operation_status=true, and 0.0 is out of range for Cooling. New error code, not previously documented (only 00002/00007 known before this).
wind_volume=0 was accepted without error -- supports the provisional 'wind_volume 0 = auto' guess in const.py.

outside_temp is still 999.0 even though the unit is now on -- contradicts the theory that 999.0 only appears while off; possibly a stale/slow-updating outdoor sensor reading, or this installation's outdoor sensor doesn't report at all. Needs more observation.
